_about: Phase 10.7 Skill Trails data for the first 6 hikers. Field names are a suggestion: fit them to the repo's data format. Text is player-facing. [Brackets] are first guesses: move them to balance.ts with TODO(wyatt). Nov 26 evening: a step's optional `levels` lists its levels past the first (26-fixes-and-wyatt-trees.md, section 5.1); Wyatt's Daredevil Loop and Scout Trail are from section 5.2 and 5.3.

kinds.usable: Button with limited uses. Round badge.
kinds.toggle: On or off until switched. Square badge, filled when on, outlined when off. Text shows 'On:' and 'Off:'.
kinds.grant: Gives something once when learned (recipes, items). Diamond badge. If picked at the start of a run, show startText.

steps.upgrade: Smaller badge of the trait it upgrades, arrow on top, II/III tag. Replaces that trait; 'changed' lists what to show in yellow.

steps.name: Leash Puller
steps.on: Finn's Move All costs him 2 Energy instead of any Appetite.

steps.name: Leash Puller II
steps.on: Finn's Move All costs him 2 Energy instead of any Appetite.
steps.off: Each hiker Finn brings along with Move All has a [25%] chance to cost no Appetite and not use their action.

steps.name: Leash Puller III
steps.on: Finn's Move All costs him 2 Energy instead of any Appetite.
steps.off: Each hiker brought along has a [50%] chance to cost no Appetite. Finn can bring hikers who already acted, and nobody loses an action.
changed: off: bring hikers who already acted

steps.name: Whatcha Up To?
steps.text: Being brought along by a Move All costs Finn no Appetite.

steps.name: Whatcha Up To? II
steps.text: Being brought along by a Move All costs Finn no Appetite and doesn't use his action.

steps.name: Never Alone
steps.text: Moving onto a tile where another hiker already is costs Finn no action and no Appetite.

steps.name: Copydog
steps.text: When Finn scavenges, he gets 1 more of the resource he keeps for each hiker who scavenged his tile earlier this phase.

steps.name: Copydog II
steps.text: Finn gets 1 more of the resource he keeps for each hiker who scavenged his tile earlier this phase. If he's the first to scavenge it, he sees 2 more cards.

steps.name: Copydog III
steps.text: Finn gets 1 more of the resource he keeps for each hiker who scavenged his tile earlier this phase. Scavenging first costs him no Appetite, and he sees 2 more cards when he scavenges last.
steps.note: First and last are on Finn's tile this phase. Alone, he is both first and last.

steps.name: Garbage Connoisseur
steps.text: When crafting food, Ellie can use Metal, Stone or Flint in place of Meat, Fish or Mushroom. Each one swapped in makes every bite give 1 less Appetite.

steps.name: Garbage Connoisseur II
steps.text: Swapped-in resources no longer lower the Appetite.

steps.name: Garbage Connoisseur III
steps.text: Each swapped-in resource adds 1 Appetite to every bite instead.

steps.name: Furrager
steps.text: Fur is much more likely when Ellie scavenges.

steps.name: Furrager II
steps.text: Fur she finds comes as x2 or x3, and she has a small chance to find Fur on tiles without a Wildlife node.

steps.name: Fur Trade
steps.text: Ellie learns a recipe: 3 Fur for 1 resource of her choice. It takes her action, like crafting. No limit.

steps.name: Singer
steps.text: For 1 Energy, every hiker on Ellie's tile gains 1 Morale.

steps.name: Loud
steps.text: When Ellie Keeps Watch, it also covers the tiles next to her.

steps.name: Singer II
steps.text: Every hiker on Ellie's tile and the tiles next to her gains 2 Morale. No Energy.

steps.name: Dog Mom
steps.text: When a Dog scavenges on Mom's tile, she gains a random resource from one of the tile's nodes.

steps.name: Agility Class
steps.text: For 1 Energy, a Dog on Mom's tile gets another action this phase.

steps.name: Agility Class II
steps.text: A Dog on Mom's tile gets another action this phase. No Energy.

steps.name: MBA
steps.text: Caps are more likely when Mom scavenges.

steps.name: MBA II
steps.text: Caps are more likely, and Caps cards she finds give 2 more Caps.

steps.name: MBA III
steps.text: Caps cards in her scavenge are kept automatically, and she still picks another card.

steps.name: Experienced Traveler
steps.text: Moving alone has a [25%] chance to cost Mom no Appetite.

steps.name: Experienced Traveler II
steps.text: Moving alone: [50%]. Being brought along by a Move All: a [25%] chance to cost no Appetite.

steps.name: Experienced Traveler III
steps.text: Moving alone: [50%]. Being brought along never costs Mom Appetite, and she gains 1 Morale each time she moves.

steps.name: Family Cookbook
steps.text: Learn 3 random food recipes.

steps.name: Artisan Chef
steps.text: Gdog can craft Tier 2 food, and sees 1 more card when crafting food.

steps.name: Master Chef
steps.text: She can craft Tier 3 food, and sees 2 more cards when crafting food.

steps.name: Clothing Catalogue
steps.text: Learn 3 random clothes recipes.

steps.name: Artisan Seamstress
steps.text: Gdog can craft Tier 2 clothes, and sees 1 more card when crafting clothes.

steps.name: Master Seamstress
steps.text: She can craft Tier 3 clothes, and sees 2 more cards when crafting clothes.

steps.name: Short
steps.text: Moving alone costs Gdog 1 less Appetite. -1 item slot.

steps.name: Short II
steps.text: Moving alone costs Gdog 1 less Appetite. Being brought along by a Move All costs her 1 less Appetite too, and the item slot comes back.

steps.name: Homemade
steps.text: When crafting, Gdog sees 1 more card and has +1 Luck.

steps.name: Lead the Way
steps.text: Hikers Wink brings along with Move All don't use their action.

steps.name: Lead the Way II
steps.text: Hikers Wink brings along don't use their action, and his Move All costs 1 less Appetite in total.

steps.name: Just Around the Next Corner
steps.text: Within 3 tiles of the checkpoint, each hiker in Wink's Move All has a [50%] chance to cost no Appetite.

steps.name: Floor Plans
steps.text: Learn 3 random shelter recipes.

steps.name: Artisan Architect
steps.text: Wink can craft Tier 2 shelters, and sees 1 more card when crafting shelters.

steps.name: Master Architect
steps.text: He can craft Tier 3 shelters, and sees 2 more cards when crafting shelters.

steps.name: Packed Toolbox
steps.text: Gain 2 random Tier 1 tools.

steps.name: The Proper Way
steps.text: Tools in Wink's pack have 1 more use. The extra use is lost if the tool is traded away.

steps.name: Prepper
steps.text: Wink doesn't set off challenges that are already revealed (by anyone). The challenge stays for the others.
steps.note: Moving onto that tile with other hikers: they do the challenge, Wink sits it out (no reward, no penalty). Moving there alone: nothing happens and the challenge stays.

steps.name: Rain Lover
steps.text: During any weather (not Clear), Wyatt has +1 Luck and sees 1 more card when scavenging.

steps.name: Rain Lover II
steps.text: During weather, +2 Luck and 1 more card when scavenging.

steps.name: Rain Lover III
steps.text: During weather, +2 Luck, 1 more card when scavenging, and all XP Wyatt earns is doubled.

steps.name: Rule Changer
steps.text: Switch a revealed minigame challenge next to Wyatt for a random one of the same tier.

levels.text: Switch a revealed minigame challenge next to Wyatt: pick 1 of 2 of the same tier.
Switch a revealed minigame challenge next to Wyatt: pick 1 of 4 of the same tier.

steps.name: Rule Changer II
steps.text: As Rule Changer. When Wyatt lands on a minigame challenge, the first Prepare slot is free.
changed: the first Prepare slot is free

levels.text: As Rule Changer. When Wyatt lands on a minigame challenge, the first two Prepare slots are free.
changed: the first two Prepare slots are free

steps.name: Minigame Master
steps.on: The next minigame challenge Wyatt lands on is passed without playing, for [4] Energy from Wyatt. Then this turns off. Once per section.

levels.on: The next minigame challenge Wyatt lands on is passed without playing, for [3] Energy from Wyatt. Then this turns off. Once per section.
The next minigame challenge Wyatt lands on is passed without playing, for [2] Energy from Wyatt. Then this turns off. Twice per section.

steps.name: Game Sight
steps.text: At the start of each phase, each minigame challenge next to Wyatt has a [25%] chance to be revealed.

levels.text: At the start of each phase, each minigame challenge next to Wyatt has a [50%] chance to be revealed.
At the start of each phase, each minigame challenge next to Wyatt has a [75%] chance to be revealed.
At the start of each phase, every minigame challenge next to Wyatt is revealed.
changed: every minigame challenge next to Wyatt is revealed

steps.name: Game Sight II
steps.text: As Game Sight, up to 2 tiles away.

levels.text: As Game Sight, up to 3 tiles away.

steps.name: Game Sight III
steps.text: As Game Sight II, and it reveals cost cards too.
changed: and it reveals cost cards too

levels.text: As Game Sight II, and it reveals cost cards and opportunities too.
